5260.title: OS-managed TLS roots omitted from hosted account requests
5260.rootCauseOneLine: Default Node TLS excludes an OS-readable root; hosted account-link transport turns certificate rejection into a generic network error.
5260.proposedFix: Review a consistent system-root trust policy across process startup paths, with negative-chain and runtime-compatibility tests. No autopilot fix: changing TLS trust is outside the allowed simple-fix security boundary.
5260.caveats: Two clean Linux source checkouts reproduce the TLS/account transport mechanism. macOS, packaged Electron, inspection appliances, CA rotation, and npm child installation were not exercised.
